component.name: core.openwop.connections.google-workspace
component.description: Google Workspace connection pack (RFC 0095) — OAuth2 PKCE provider for Drive, Calendar, and Gmail via the Google APIs. Registry parity for the reference app's BUILT-IN `google` provider (day-1 UX P10 / C3): the app itself never loads this pack (the builtin wins by id precedence anyway — this pack deliberately uses the distinct id `google-workspace` so OTHER hosts can adopt it without shadowing semantics); it exists so packs.openwop.dev offers a Google productivity-suite connection alongside microsoft365 — previously the registry's only Google entry was google-ads. Read scopes are the day-1 consent; gmail.send / calendar.events are WRITE groups behind a separate re-consent (ADR 0024 §3). Carries NO secret; the operator supplies the OAuth client id/secret host-side (ADR 0024 §7).
